subject: general
question:
A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 7 g/cm³. It's internal and external radii are 0 cm and 3 cm respectively. What is the approximte weight (in kg) of the shell? 

Take π=(22)/(7) and Densty=(mass)/(volume)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Mass** = **Density** × **Volume**

**Volume** of shell = 4/3 × π × (R³ − r³)

**Mass** = 7 × (4/3 × 22/7 × (3³ − 0³)) = 4/3 × 22 × 27 = 88 × 9 = 792 g

**Weight** in **kg** = 792 ÷ 1000 = 0.792 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 0.792 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**External radius** (R) = 3 cm

**Internal radius** (r) = 0 cm

**Density** (ρ) = 7 g/cm³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45e4b15a20d2f1a4a0783950bfa19b1a1f2a081d8b905f47b7240bd5cbf00f4a.png] 

**Formula Used:**

**Volume of Sphere** = 4/3 × π × R³

**Mass** = **Density** × **Volume**

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Volume** = 4/3 × 22/7 × (3)³

⇒ **Volume** = 4/3 × 22/7 × 27

⇒ **Volume** = 4 × 22/7 × 9 = 792/7 cm³

⇒ **Mass** = **Density** × **Volume**

⇒ **Mass** = 7 × (792/7) = 792 g

⇒ **Weight** in **kg** = 792 ÷ 1000

⇒ **Weight** = 0.792 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 0.792 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Hollow Sphere

The volume of a hollow spherical shell is given by V = 4/3 × π × (R³ − r³), where R is the **outer radius** and r is the **inner radius**.

Mass and Density Relation

The relationship is **Mass = Density × Volume**. Ensure units are consistent (e.g., g/cm³ with cm³ results in grams).

Unit Conversion

To convert **grams to kilograms**, divide the value by 1000 since 1 kg = 1000 g.</p
